title: Kanda 19: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 19.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 19.

verses.original: शान्ता द्यौः शान्ता पृथिवी शान्तमिदमुर्वन्तरिक्षम् । शान्ता उदन्वतीरापः शान्ता नः सन्त्वोषधीः ॥
verses.transliteration: śāntā dyauḥ śāntā pṛthivī śāntamidamurvantarikṣam | śāntā udanvatīrāpaḥ śāntā naḥ santvoṣadhīḥ ||
verses.translation: Peaceful be the heavens, peaceful be the earth, peaceful be the vast atmosphere! Peaceful be the oceanic waters, peaceful unto us be all plants and trees!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The universal Atharvan peace chant: establishing cosmic serenity across elements, nature, and human society.

layers.author: whitney
